pairs: accedens ad servitutem Dei sta in justitia
when you apply yourself to the service of God,
stand in justice and in fear,
et præpara animam tuam ad tentationem.
and prepare your soul for temptation.
et ne festines in tempore obductionis.
And you should not hurry away in the time of distress.
ut crescat in novissimo vita tua.
so that your life may increase in the very end.
Omne quod tibi applicitum fuerit accipe:
Accept everything that will happen to you,
et in humilitate tua patientiam habe:
and have patience in your humiliation.
For gold and silver are tested in fire,
homines vero receptibiles in camino humiliationis.
acceptable men are tested in the furnace of humiliation.
and he will restore you to health.
And do not turn away from him,
And your reward will not be taken away.
Qui timetis Dominum, sperate in illum,
You who fear the Lord, hope in him.
et in oblectationem veniet vobis misericordia.
And mercy will approach you, to your delight.
And your hearts will be illuminated.
and know that not one of them hoped in the Lord
et scitote quia nullus speravit in Domino et confusus est.
Quis enim permansit in mandatis ejus,
For who has remained in his commandment
Or who has called upon him,
Quoniam pius et misericors est Deus,
For God is upright and merciful,
et remittet in die tribulationis peccata,
and he will forgive sins in the day of tribulation.
et protector est omnibus exquirentibus se in veritate.
And he is the Protector to all those who seek him in truth.
and to the hands that do evil,
et peccatori terram ingredienti duabus viis!
and to the sinner who walks the earth by two ways!
Woe to the dissolute in heart,
who do not trust God! For,
et ideo non protegentur ab eo!
as a result, they will not be protected by him.
Woe to those who have lost endurance,
and who have abandoned upright ways,
and who have turned aside to depraved ways!
Et quid facient cum inspicere cœperit Dominus?
And what will they do when the Lord begins to examine them?
Qui timent Dominum non erunt incredibiles verbo illius:
Those who fear the Lord will not be unbelieving toward his Word.
et qui diligunt illum conservabunt viam illius.
And those who love him will keep to his way.
Qui timent Dominum inquirent quæ beneplacita sunt ei,
Those who fear the Lord will seek the things that are well-pleasing to him.
et qui diligunt eum replebuntur lege ipsius.
And those who love him will be filled with his law.
Qui timent Dominum præparabunt corda sua,
Those who fear the Lord will prepare their hearts,
et in conspectu illius sanctificabunt animas suas.
and they will sanctify their souls in his sight.
Qui timent Dominum custodiunt mandata illius,
Those who fear the Lord keep his commandments,
et patientiam habebunt usque ad inspectionem illius,
and they will have patience even until his examination,
then we will fall into the hands of the Lord,
and not into the hands of men.”
sic et misericordia illius cum ipso est.
so also is his mercy with him.
